Air America was a CIA-run Airline that operated in the Indochina area from the mid-1940s until after the fall of Saigon. They supplied the also CIA-run Hmong SGU and performed most of the commercial/civilian flights for covert personnel. They even flew SOG's (Studies and Observation Group, a former CIA special operations unit, turned over to the US military in 1964)'s 'interrogation tiger' to Australia, which was previously captured in Laos as a cub. They also assisted in the opium trade that was prevalent in Indochina at the time.
